Definition: a set time; technically, a year
BiblicalUsage: A set time is God's time, and Daniel uses this Aramaic word for the seasons God appoints. In Daniel 2:21 God changes the times and the seasons, in Daniel 3:5 the music sounds at what time the people must fall down and worship, in Daniel 4:16 seven times pass over Nebuchadnezzar, and in Daniel 4:25 the same seven times teach the king that the Most High rules.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the times are not mine to set: God changes them, measures them, and lets them run their course. The proud learn who rules only when the times have done their work.
RelatedEvents: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace; Nebuchadnezzar's Dream of the Image; Nebuchadnezzar's Humbling
